summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 enhancements. All 4 spec points passed end-to-end. (1) MEMBER PRICE on catalog: Logged-out visit to /catalogue -> 0 elements matching [data-testid^='product-member-badge-'] (no member UI). Registered a fresh customer via POST /api/auth/register (BRONZE tier, min 0) then logged in via /compte. Revisiting /catalogue rendered exactly 1 gold 'PRIX BRONZE' badge with data-testid product-member-badge-6a8399a0fd8830baee58e7a4 and product-member-price-6a8399a0fd8830baee58e7a4 = '2 963 DA' (=3 950 x 0.75). Non-covered products showed no member badge. (2) MEMBER PRICE on product detail /produit/6a8399a0fd8830baee58e7a4: data-testid product-member-badge text 'Prix membre BRONZE' + product-member-price '2 963 DA' with original '3 950 DA' rendered as struck-through (line-through). Clicking product-add-to-cart added the item to cart at the member price - header cart badge showed '1  2 963 DA' confirming the discounted price propagates to the cart total. (3) ADMIN gift-claims: In Admin > Fidélité the gift-claims-table renders with heading 'Cadeaux réclamés (2)'; two rows present: gift-claim-row-0 = Alice Test / BRONZE / Eucerin Bandages Advanced / CADEAU-B1595C / Utilisé / 24/08/2026 and gift-claim-row-1 = Gift Flow / BRONZE / Trousse cadeau Bronze / CADEAU-1DA211 / Utilisé / 24/08/2026. Columns Client / Statut / Cadeau / Code / État / Date all shown. (4) BULK selector cumulative: In offer-products-0-selector (Promo Bronze offer), clicking category Santé produced 8 products and 'Tout sélectionner (8)  — cumulé entre catégories' label visible; clicking select-all raised chips from 1 to 9 (1 initial + 8). Switching to a DIFFERENT category (Visage) and clicking Tout sélectionner again raised chips to 17 - both categories accumulated (chip counter shows '17 sélectionnés'). The '— cumulé entre catégories' label is present next to the Tout sélectionner button. CLEANUP performed: authenticated as admin (POST /api/auth/login with identifier field) and PUT /api/settings with loyalty_offers=[]; verified GET /api/settings returns loyalty_offers length 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is still ~1700 lines - LoyaltyAdminPanel/GiftsPanel/ProductForm should be split into separate files (carry-over from iter-22).
MemberPricingContext fetches /loyalty/member-pricing on every login; consider adding a lightweight cache-busting mechanism when admin updates offers so tier changes propagate without re-login.

BulkProductSelector still issues per-id GET /products/:id in parallel for each selected chip - with 17 chips selected we observed 17 parallel requests on the network tab. A batch endpoint would help (carry-over).
